description: This file defines the AWS imagebuilderClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the EC2 Image Builder service, including creating, deleting, and retrieving image components, pipelines, and configurations.

classes.name: imagebuilderClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS EC2 Image Builder service, providing methods for managing image components, pipelines, and configurations.

methods.name: cancelImageCreationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels the image creation process.

methods.name: createComponentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new image component.

methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific component.
